newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian CPI rises 0.13 percent in December.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian CPI rises 0.13 percent in December.

text.p: The Palestinian consumer price index in the Gaza Strip, the West Bank and Arab East Jerusalem, rose 0.13 percent in December, the Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics (PCBS) said on Tuesday.

The PCBS said in a statement that the rise followed a 0.34 percent drop in November. The increase brought the inflation rate between November 1995 (when the PCBS began calculating the CPI) and December 1996 to 8.04 percent.
The report attributed the December increase to a rise in the price of clothing, footwear and medical services. It said prices of food and transport dropped in December.

The PCBS said the sharpest CPI rise in December was recorded in the Gaza Strip where prices rose by 0.96 percent, compared to a drop of 0.28 percent in Arab East Jerusalem. The rest of the West Bank registered a rise of only 0.09 percent, the PCBS said.
